messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT OPENED: High error rate routing enterprise requests for Orion Health (private, eu-west-1) — automated detection at 07:22 UTC. Pager triggered to oncall rotation. Incident channel: #inc-2148765432
Elaine (oncall): 👋 I'm on it. pulling logs and checking recent deploys. starting a live timeline.
Ron (ops): seeing 504 spikes from the gateway proxies -> downstream dedicated pool. replicated in staging eu-west mirror.
Jin (support): FYI CE pinged: Orion Health impacted for API calls that hit private endpoints; they're on an SLA plan. They asked for ETA and contact routing.
Maya (CE): I have primary contact list: Sarah Chen (VP Ops), tinch@orionhealth.com; backup: marcus@orionhealth.com. They expect a customer-facing statement within 30 mins. I'll prep.
Sam (infra): quick check: a node pool autoscaler flapped and then kube-proxy restarted on a subset of nodes at 07:18. suspecting session affinity / sticky routing lost.
Elaine (oncall): rolling a traffic drain on pool eu-dedicated-03 to force failover to eu-dedicated-01/02. command:
```bash
redwoodctl pool drain --name eu-dedicated-03 --grace-period 30s
```
Elaine (oncall): also enabling fallback routing to hosted-compatible model variant for Orion enterprise routes to reduce customer error surface: will flip route policy to prefer region-available.
Ron (ops): done drain, starting health checks. error rate down slightly but still elevated. tracing shows 502 from nginx -> backend TLS handshake failures on node set A.
Sam (infra): digging into certificates / SNI mismatch. I see an expired cert in node-set-A for cert-manager-managed sidecar (rotated incorrectly). rotating now.
ce-svcs-bot: NOTE: Incident classification: enterprise-impacting; must notify customers via status page and email template.
Maya (CE): Draft status page update (please review):
```
Status: Degraded performance impacting Orion Health private requests in eu-west-1.
Start time: 2024-11-02 07:18 UTC
Impact: Some API requests may return 5xx or experience elevated latency. We are draining affected nodes and routing traffic to healthy pools.
Mitigation: Rolling node-side cert rotation and traffic reroute in progress.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when status changes.
```
Jin (support): Customer email draft (tailored):
"Hi Sarah — we're investigating elevated errors for your private eu-west-1 deployment. We're actively rerouting traffic to healthy pools and expect reduced errors within the hour. We'll send another update in 30 minutes. For urgent needs call +1-555-0112 (oncall) or reply to this thread"
Elaine (oncall): @Maya add recommended workaround: temporarily point Orion Health traffic to fallback endpoint host: orion-fallback.eu.redwood.ai (TTL 60) — only if they opt in. Also include note about no data loss expected.
Maya (CE): adding workaround note. prepping email + status page publish. cc: legal for SLA language?
Jin (support): I'm standing by to send the email and to escalate to account team once we have the official wording.
Sam (infra): cert rotation completed on node-set-A at 07:46 UTC. backend TLS errors no longer present in new traces.
Ron (ops): error rate trending down to baseline but some 504s during failover window. will keep watching for 15m.
Elaine (oncall): updating incident timeline and assigning follow-ups:
- Postmortem owner: Ron
- Customer comms: Maya/Jin
- Infra RCA: Sam
- Rollback/fallback check: Elaine
I'll close when sustained 15m of normal error rates.
Maya (CE): Published status page update and queued customer email to Sarah/Marcus. copy of status page entry: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2148765432 (draft live).
ce-svcs-bot: ACTION LOGGED: customer notification sent by Maya at 07:52 UTC (threaded).
Jin (support): received reply from Sarah: "Thanks — confirming received, please keep me posted. We have a mini-retro on our side at 10:00 if you need it."
Elaine (oncall): monitoring: 20m stable, error rate within SLO. moving to mitigated state but keeping channel open for postmortem notes.
Ron (ops): filing RCA ticket: "Orion Health - expired cert rotation caused backend TLS handshake failures -> routing errors during autoscaler window" and linking incident id 2148765432.
Maya (CE): internal comms template for CSMs (finalized):
```
Subject: Incident affecting Orion Health private (eu-west-1) - Mitigated
Body: Hi team, we experienced elevated 5xx errors for Orion Health's private endpoint due to a cert rotation issue. Impact was limited to routing errors; traffic was rerouted and certs rotated. No data loss. Point-of-contact: Maya (CE) and Elaine (oncall). Postmortem ticket: INC-2148765432-RCA. Please defer direct technical questions to ops/infra.
```
Elaine (oncall): closing notes: please add any missing owners to the RCA. Will publish postmortem in 48 hours with mitigation and steps to prevent cert rotation race. :white_check_mark:
Sam (infra): adding cleanup task to ensure cert-manager controllers have stronger preflight checks.
Jin (support): marking customer case resolved after confirmation from Sarah.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: status -> mitigated at 08:12 UTC. Channel will remain for postmortem. :information_source:
